name: sitemap-toxml-callback-removed-netlify-plugin-sitemap
behavioral_change: sitemap v4.0.0 removed the callback form of `Sitemap.prototype.toXML`. In v_old (3.2.2) `toXML(callback)` invoked the callback via process.nextTick and could be wrapped with `util.promisify`; in v_new (4.1.1) `toXML(pretty)` synchronously returns `this.toString(pretty)`, so a passed function is coerced to a boolean and never called.
downstream_effect: The downstream project awaits `util.promisify(sitemap.toXML.bind(sitemap))()` in make_sitemap.js:75, and the resulting Promise never settles, so file writing and all later steps never run. All 21 tests fail with ava's own "Error: Promise returned by test never resolved", with no frame in make_sitemap.js, no mention of toXML or sitemap, and two `util.promisify` calls in the file to distinguish between.
reference_fix: The reference fix deletes the line `await util.promisify(sitemap.toXML.bind(sitemap))()` in make_sitemap.js:75, since the next line `const xml = sitemap.toString()` already obtains the same XML.
documented_in: The sitemap.js CHANGELOG 4.0.0 section (https://github.com/ekalinin/sitemap.js/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) lists "Remove callback on toXML - This had no performance benefit" among breaking changes; it does not say the first parameter became `pretty` and gives no code for the new call form, so the reference fix was derived from the 4.1.1 implementation of toXML and toString.
